categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai OPM Biosciences Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: cell culture media products and biopharmaceutical contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) services. The company provides a comprehensive range of cell culture media tailored for various cell types including CHO, HEK293, insect cells, and vaccine-related cells. Its CDMO services cover antibody engineering, cell line development, process development, pilot and commercial production, and quality analysis, supporting clients from early research to commercial drug production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in chemically defined serum-free cell culture media with complex formulations containing 70-100 chemical components optimized for high-density cell culture and protein expression. It employs advanced cell line construction technologies, including stable and transient transfection platforms, and integrates upstream and downstream bioprocess development. Manufacturing is conducted in GMP-compliant facilities with large-scale dry powder and liquid media production lines, utilizing precise component mixing and dissolution control to ensure batch consistency. The CDMO platform includes state-of-the-art equipment and disposable systems to prevent cross-contamination and supports clinical phase III and commercial production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: OPM Biosciences serves over 800 domestic and international biopharmaceutical companies and research institutions, including innovative drug developers and vaccine manufacturers. Its products and services support the entire biopharmaceutical development lifecycle, from preclinical research to clinical trials and commercial production. The company’s customer base includes entities involved in monoclonal antibody production, recombinant proteins, vaccines, cell and gene therapies, and veterinary vaccines.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and production facilities in Shanghai and subsidiaries in Taicang and the United States. It has a growing international presence, particularly in the US market through its wholly-owned subsidiary OPM Biosciences Inc. Overseas revenue increased significantly by over 140% in 2024, reflecting successful global expansion and international client acquisition.
categories.supply_chain_position: OPM Biosciences operates upstream and midstream in the biopharmaceutical supply chain. It produces critical raw materials (cell culture media) essential for biologics manufacturing and provides integrated CDMO services that encompass cell line development, process optimization, and commercial drug production, thereby bridging early-stage research and large-scale manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on continuous innovation in chemically defined serum-free media and expanding its CDMO service capabilities to cover the full drug development cycle. R&D priorities include developing high-performance media for various cell types, enhancing protein expression yields, and supporting emerging fields such as ADCs, cell and gene therapies, and vaccines. It also invests in digitalization and automation to improve production efficiency and quality control. Collaborations with academic institutions and investments in new production facilities underpin its innovation and capacity expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of cell culture media and related consumables, as well as service fees from CDMO contracts. The CDMO revenue is milestone-based or project-based, recognizing income upon completion of specific development stages or delivery of research outcomes. The company also earns interest income from financial investments and government subsidies related to its operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: OPM Biosciences competes with major international suppliers of cell culture media such as Thermo Fisher, Merck, and Danaher, as well as domestic biotech firms offering CDMO services. It positions itself as a leading domestic innovator with a comprehensive product portfolio and integrated service platform, emphasizing cost-effectiveness, high quality, and localized supply chain advantages. The company has successfully broken import monopolies in China’s cell culture media market and is expanding its global footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 297 million, a 22.26% increase over 2023, driven by a 42% growth in product sales and a 144% increase in overseas revenue. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 21 million, down 61% due to increased fixed costs from new production facilities, asset impairment, and loss of tax incentives. The company maintains a strong asset base of over RMB 2.2 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures representing 11.5% of revenue. It has a workforce of 328 employees, including 44 dedicated R&D personnel.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: OPM Biosciences offers high-quality, chemically defined serum-free cell culture media that match or exceed the performance of imported products, enabling higher protein yields and stable batch-to-batch consistency. Its integrated CDMO platform provides end-to-end biopharmaceutical development and manufacturing services, reducing clients’ time to market and production costs. The company’s domestic production capabilities ensure supply chain security and responsiveness, while its continuous innovation and customization services meet diverse client needs across multiple biopharmaceutical sectors.
